description:
Title: Instruct an artist to create a 3D model print it on a 3D printer

When craving a custom 3D model, as a first step you have to instruct an artist to create a project for you.
First you have to send him several sketches, and then tell him what to change until you are satisfied with the result.
After that, you choose a plastic color you want to use for 3D printing.
If you have the color at home (in stock), you check how much color you have left.
If it's under 100 grams, you put it on your shopping list.
If you do not have the color at home, you order it.
When you have the plastic, you can turn the printer on and heat up the bed and the extruder (it continuously sends you back its status).
While doing that, you can generate the gcode file for your printer out of the STL sent to you by the artist.
After that you print the model.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_3DPrint" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/3d-print">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProjectInstruction" name="Project instruction"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Sketches" name="Sketches"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ChangeRequest" name="Change instructions"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_STL" name="STL model"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_3DPrint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_User" name="You" processRef="Process_User"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist" processRef="Process_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Printer" name="3D printer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProjectInstruction" name="Project instruction" sourceRef="Task_InstructArtist" targetRef="Start_ArtistInstruction" messageRef="Message_ProjectInstruction"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Sketches" name="Sketches" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialSTL" name="STL model" sourceRef="Task_SendInitialSTL" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ChangeRequest" name="Change instructions" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Task_ReceiveChanges" messageRef="Message_ChangeRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RevisedSTL" name="Updated STL model" sourceRef="Task_SendRevisedSTL" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status" sourceRef="Participant_Printer" targetRef="Start_PrinterStatus" messageRef="Message_PrinterStatus"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_User" name="Instruct an artist to create a 3D model and print it" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Craving" name="Crave a custom 3D model"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InstructArtist" name="Instruct artist to create a project" messageRef="Message_ProjectInstruction"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSketches" name="Send sketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSTL" name="Receive STL model" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Satisfaction" name="Satisfied with the result?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendChanges" name="Tell artist what to change" messageRef="Message_ChangeRequest"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseColor" name="Choose plastic color"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ColorAtHome" name="Color at home?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckQuantity" name="Check amount of color left"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Under100" name="Under 100 grams?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddShoppingList" name="Put color on shopping list"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_OrderPlastic" name="Order plastic"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ColorPathMerge" name="Merge plastic availability paths"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TurnOnPrinter" name="Turn on printer"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PrintPreparationSplit" name="Prepare printer and gcode"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_HeatPrinter" name="Heat bed and extruder"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_GenerateGcode" name="Generate gcode from STL"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PrintPreparationJoin" name="Printer and gcode ready"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PrintModel" name="Print model"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ModelPrinted" name="Model printed"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_PrinterStatus" name="Receive ongoing printer status" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status received" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PrinterStatus" messageRef="Message_PrinterStatus"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PrinterStatus" name="Status received"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusReceived" sourceRef="Start_PrinterStatus" targetRef="End_PrinterStatus"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_01" sourceRef="Start_Craving" targetRef="Task_InstructArtist"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_02" sourceRef="Task_InstructArtist" targetRef="Task_SendSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_03" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_04" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSTL" targetRef="Gateway_Satisfaction"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Satisfied" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfaction" targetRef="Task_ChooseColor">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">satisfiedWithResult</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotSatisfied" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfaction" targetRef="Task_SendChanges">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">notSatisfiedWithResult</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_05" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_06" sourceRef="Task_ChooseColor" targetRef="Gateway_ColorAtHome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ColorAtHome" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorAtHome" targetRef="Task_CheckQuantity">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">colorAtHome</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ColorNotAtHome" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorAtHome" targetRef="Task_OrderPlastic">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">notColorAtHome</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_07" sourceRef="Task_CheckQuantity" targetRef="Gateway_Under100"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Under100" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Task_AddShoppingList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">amountInGrams < 100</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AtLeast100" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Gateway_ColorPathMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">amountInGrams >= 100</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_08" sourceRef="Task_AddShoppingList" targetRef="Gateway_ColorPathMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_09" sourceRef="Task_OrderPlastic" targetRef="Gateway_ColorPathMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_10" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorPathMerge" targetRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_11" sourceRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter" targetRef="Gateway_PrintPreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_12" sourceRef="Gateway_PrintPreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_HeatPrinter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_13" sourceRef="Gateway_PrintPreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_GenerateGcode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_14" sourceRef="Task_HeatPrinter" targetRef="Gateway_PrintPreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_15" sourceRef="Task_GenerateGcode" targetRef="Gateway_PrintPreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_16" sourceRef="Gateway_PrintPreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_PrintModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_17" sourceRef="Task_PrintModel" targetRef="End_ModelPrinted"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Artist" name="Create and revise the 3D model" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ArtistInstruction" name="Project instruction received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ArtistInstruction" messageRef="Message_ProjectInstruction"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSketches" name="Receive sketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CreateModel" name="Create 3D model"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInitialSTL" name="Send STL model" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveChanges" name="Receive change instructions" messageRef="Message_ChangeRequest"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviseModel" name="Revise 3D model"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRevisedSTL" name="Send updated STL model" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RevisedModelSent" name="Updated STL sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_01" sourceRef="Start_ArtistInstruction" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_02" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSketches" targetRef="Task_CreateModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_03" sourceRef="Task_CreateModel" targetRef="Task_SendInitialSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_04" sourceRef="Task_SendInitialSTL" targetRef="Task_ReceiveChanges"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_05" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveChanges" targetRef="Task_ReviseModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_06" sourceRef="Task_ReviseModel" targetRef="Task_SendRevisedSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_07" sourceRef="Task_SendRevisedSTL" targetRef="End_RevisedModelSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
